outcome: maternal outcomes (comorbidities, insulin necessity, induction methods, delivery mode)
fetal outcomes (macrosomia, shoulder dystocia, preterm labor, IUGR, stillbirth, NICU admission)
cohort: 120 pregnant women at Government Dharmapuri Medical College Hospital, Dharmapuri, India, followed from May 2023 to October 2023.
finding: Women with GDM on insulin experienced more adverse maternal and fetal complications compared to women with normal OGCT values.
